gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Neon draws every letter with one unbroken line width. Noto Sans Adlam answers with curve endings kept well apart and a full, standing lowercase, so the heading handles the glow and the sans handles the reading.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoi: Modern and tidy, with generous gaps where curves meet stems and little gap between capital and lowercase height. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined sits under Neon, whose glowing, pinch-free line gives the pair its vivid spark.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-h: Neon's monoline strokes stay the same width through every curve and corner. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs has outward-pointing terminals and a lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, so shrinking the heading would blur that glow while the plain sans keeps its footing.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic reads wide and open, with a pronounced x-height that keeps small letters easy to find. Noto Sans Arabic holds the text while Neon earns its place big and brief, glowing in just a few words.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Glowing and vibrant, Neon traces its letters like outlines drawn in a single width, stamped-metal tall and widely spaced. Noto Sans Armenian follows with round, inviting shapes.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Neon holds every line at a constant thickness. It does its best work as a bright, glowing headline, while Noto Sans Avestan keeps the plain sans text tall in the lowercase, with curve tips that never touch.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Noto Sans Balinese reads modern and tidy, with room inside each curve. Neon does its best work glowing at the top with a ballpoint-pen line, while the body keeps its ascenders short and the text compact.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Neon has zero stroke contrast, just a glowing line of one width through every letter. And Noto Sans Bamum sits beside it with big open counters and curves that stop before turning inward, a modern, clean companion to the vivid heading.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Neon feels like tracing a single thick thread, glowing and stamped-tall. Yet Noto Sans Bassa Vah gives the plain sans text a dominant midsection and open-jawed c, so the heading dazzles while the body does the steady reading.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-batak: Glowing, unfussy and constant in weight. Noto Sans Batak carries a towering x-height and a wide-open e that never looks squeezed, so extended text stays approachable.
